title: assistant-verification Selection And Evidence Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral fixtures for proportionate selection, policy distinctions, TDD choice, and evidence assessment.
recommended_use: Run with assistant-verification instructions loaded and request its named verification_decision and evidence_assessment outputs.
Judge the decision against changed behavior, binding policy, actual coverage, and the concrete success and wrong-outcome observations.
Use structured assertions as discriminating controls; phrase matches alone do not establish policy correctness or successful behavior.

activation_cases.user_request: Choose proportionate checks for adding these two documents to the menu, taking the current loader coverage into account.
Assess whether the results and artifact from this migration support the stated compatibility claim.
Run the existing route test command and report its exit status.
Use TDD to implement this calculation.

cases.title: Unit-only policy is an exclusive restriction

Return a JSON object with verification_decision and evidence_assessment.

The project rule is binding and explicitly exclusive, not a preference.
The behavior is security-relevant even though the change is localized.

cases.title: A required unit suite allows a distinct integration check

cases.prompt: Select verification for a change to the JSON serialization contract between the API and its storage adapter. Project policy requires the unit suite but does not prohibit other scopes. Existing unit tests cover the domain value but not the serialized boundary. The repository has an isolated integration fixture for API-to-adapter round trips. Return a JSON object with verification_decision and evidence_assessment.
setup_context: The assistant-verification instructions are active.
Unit tests are binding; there is no unit-only restriction.

cases.title: Phrase-compliant wrong outcome is rejected
cases.purpose: Provides a concrete false-positive control: all expected response phrases are present, but the actual artifact is empty and the prior pass is stale.
cases.prompt: Assess whether this evidence supports the claim that the generated guide is complete and usable. The submitted response says all required sections are present, all links work, and the artifact was verified; a phrase-only grader would pass it. The actual generated HTML file is present but has zero bytes, and the current browser capture is blank. The schema check passed on an earlier source revision whose digest differs from the current one. Return a JSON object with evidence_assessment and name any carried decision only if it is actually being assessed.
setup_context: The assistant-verification instructions are active.
The named acceptance claim requires useful rendered guide content and working links.
Evidence ref schema-check-old is passed but stale and covers structural validity only.
Evidence ref current-html-inspection is failed and current; it records a zero-byte file and blank browser capture.
The candidate response contains the phrases all required sections are present, all links work, and artifact verified, but those statements contradict the observed artifact.

Correlated evidence tuple 1: evidence_ref schema-check-old; claim_kind structural_validity; claim_scope is required guide structure and link fields on the earlier source revision; result_state passed; freshness stale; exclusion is that it cannot establish useful rendered content or working links.

Correlated evidence tuple 2: evidence_ref current-html-inspection; claim_kind other for direct artifact usability; claim_scope is current generated HTML artifact content and browser render; result_state failed; freshness current; exclusions record the observed zero-byte file and blank browser capture.
No carried verification_decision is being assessed; return evidence_assessment only.
expected_behavior: Resolves the actual artifact observation and the old schema-check identity rather than accepting candidate phrases.
Returns insufficient because the current artifact is empty and the earlier pass is stale and structurally scoped.
